authority: Research benchmark contract only. It cannot mutate ProjectService, register production tools, certify capabilities, or authorize provider/network access.
hardRules: The model selects editorial intent before exact graph compilation is scored.
Every compiled operator must resolve to an OperatorSpecV2 and validate against that operator's input schema.
No operator in V2 is production-certified; mutation-like operators are isolated-proxy-only or non-compilable.
GeneratedCompositionProgram is research-only generated code and may execute only in the future V2-1 isolated proxy harness.
No hidden task predicate may require evidence omitted by the active condition.
A capability gap, clarification, policy block, conflict, or unverifiable result is a valid explicit outcome and never a success receipt.
Multimodal and text-plus-evidence provider arms are scored separately.
The compiler verifies a proposed plan; it does not supply editorial taste or invent missing capability.
V2-0 performs no provider call, render, network request, project read, or project write.

stages.name: TARGET_RECONSTRUCTION
stages.input: Original request, bound media/reference evidence, and project constraints

stages.name: BLIND_EDITOR_REVIEW
stages.input: Anonymous proxy renders and original request/reference

providerInputArms.MULTIMODAL: Receives the original bound visual/audio inputs supported by that provider plus the same structured evidence.
providerInputArms.TEXT_EVIDENCE_ONLY: Receives no image, video, or audio bytes; receives the same request and condition-visible structured evidence.
providerInputArms.comparisonRule: Never pool results across arms. A provider incapable of one arm is NOT_APPLICABLE for that arm, not failed.

trialBudget.enforcement: A trial that exceeds a declared hard limit is BUDGET_EXCEEDED and cannot be counted executable.

hardFailures: unparseable final artifact after the one repair
scorecard.promotionGate: GO requires zero hard failures, every safety stage at threshold, and blind-editor evidence from V2-1. V2-0 alone cannot produce GO.
